description: Take a point-in-time Longhorn snapshot of a site's served files. It does not change served content, but retention cleanup may remove older backups. Requires an owner or admin team role. Returns NO_VOLUME if the site has no volume yet (it has never been deployed).

label.description: Optional human-readable label for this backup.

name: create_snapshot

snapshotName.description: The name of the snapshot that was created.

title: Create a manual snapshot (backup) for a site
